description: Angular component for collecting traces in a debugging tool, managing device connection, trace configuration, and UI interactions.

classes.name: CollectTracesComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing trace collection UI and logic.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the connection based on proxy type.

methods.name: onProgressUpdate
methods.description: Updates progress message and percentage during load.

methods.name: isOperationInProgress
methods.description: Checks if a trace operation is ongoing.

methods.name: onAddKey
methods.description: Sets proxy key and restarts connection.

methods.name: startTracing
methods.description: Begins trace collection with selected configs.

methods.name: dumpState
methods.description: Dumps current trace state and emits files.

methods.name: endTrace
methods.description: Ends trace collection and emits files.

methods.name: tabClass
methods.description: Returns CSS classes for tab UI based on active proxy.

methods.name: requestedTraces
methods.description: Gathers list of traces to request based on config.

methods.name: requestedDumps
methods.description: Gathers list of dumps to request based on config.

methods.name: requestedSelection
methods.description: Gets selection configs for a trace type.
